body:
## What it does

Despite the name it is not a trading bot: it watches your personal inbox and calendar so school items, family plans and household follow-ups stop slipping through. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @clairevo shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
